parameters.raw_text: The rate of cholera transmission is a product of the force of infection (λ) and the size of the susceptible population (S). The force of infection in turn depends on three parameters or variables: β: the 'contact rate' between the susceptible population with contaminated water.
parameters.text_span: The rate of cholera transmission is a product of the force of infection (λ) and the size of the susceptible population (S). The force of infection in turn depends on three parameters or variables: β: the 'contact rate' between the susceptible population with contaminated water.

parameters.raw_text: The per capita recovery rate is probably the most certain of all parameters in the model. It is approximately equal to the reciprocal of the duration of infection (1/γ), a parameter that more data are available.
parameters.text_span: The per capita recovery rate is probably the most certain of all parameters in the model. It is approximately equal to the reciprocal of the duration of infection (1/γ), a parameter that more data are available.

parameters.raw_text: Cholera life span in water reservoir (1/δ) depends on the local environment. While it is largely unmeasured in many endemic or epidemic contexts, modelers can use historical experimental data from the literature and therefore this parameter is also relatively certain.

parameters.raw_text: The rate of water contamination by infectious people shedding V. cholerae into the water reservoir (ξ) depends on both bacteria shedding of the infected individuals (a biological quantity) and the level of sanitation in the environment (an environmental assessment).

parameters.raw_text: The basic reproduction number, R0, is usually defined as the number of individuals that an infected (and infectious) individual can infect when he or she is introduced into a completely susceptible population.
parameters.text_span: The basic reproduction number, R0, is usually defined as the number of individuals that an infected (and infectious) individual can infect when he or she is introduced into a completely susceptible population.

parameters.raw_text: The effective reproduction number, RE or R, is defined as the number of individuals infected by a typical infectious individual when a fraction of the population is protected from infection through immunity, prophylaxis or non-pharmaceutical interventions.
